title: Toy Story
overview: Led by Woody, Andy's toys live happily in his room until Buzz Lightyear arrives and changes everything.

title: Jumanji
overview: Two kids discover a magical board game that releases a man trapped for decades and brings jungle dangers into the real world.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who pushes Gotham City and its heroes into chaos.

title: Inception
overview: A skilled thief enters dreams to steal secrets, then takes on the risky mission of planting an idea inside a mind.

title: Interstellar
overview: A team of explorers travels through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity.

title: Parasite
overview: A poor family becomes entangled with a wealthy household, exposing sharp conflicts of class and survival.

title: La La Land
overview: An aspiring actress and a jazz musician fall in love while chasing difficult dreams in Los Angeles.

title: Whiplash
overview: A young drummer enrolls at a top music conservatory and clashes with a ruthless instructor.

title: The Matrix
overview: A hacker discovers that reality is a simulation and joins a rebellion against machine control.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A young girl enters a mysterious spirit world and must find courage to save her parents.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: A banker sentenced to prison forms a deep friendship while holding onto hope and dignity.

title: Forrest Gump
overview: Forrest Gump moves through decades of American history with innocence, luck, and devotion.

title: The Godfather
overview: The aging head of a powerful crime family transfers control to his reluctant son.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: Multiple crime stories collide in Los Angeles through sharp dialogue and unexpected violence.

title: Fight Club
overview: An office worker and a soap maker create an underground fight club that grows into something dangerous.

title: Avengers: Endgame
overview: The surviving Avengers attempt one final mission to undo the devastation caused by Thanos.

title: Coco
overview: A boy who dreams of becoming a musician journeys into the Land of the Dead to uncover his family's story.

title: Inside Out
overview: Inside a young girl's mind, her emotions struggle to guide her through a difficult move.

title: Up
overview: An elderly widower ties balloons to his house and sets off on an adventure with an unexpected young companion.

title: Your Name
overview: Two teenagers mysteriously swap bodies and form a connection across distance and time.

title: The Social Network
overview: The founding of Facebook brings ambition, lawsuits, and fractured friendships.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a wasteland ruled by tyranny, Max and Furiosa race across the desert to seek freedom.

title: Black Panther

title: Frozen
overview: A fearless princess sets out to find her sister, whose icy powers have trapped their kingdom in winter.
